UCDT v2 — Urban Climate Digital Twin for Ho Chi Minh City (flood, heat, air quality, what-if simulation, rule-based recommendations). S-001 rewrote Hackathon-BE/FE as this monorepo; S-002 made it match Figure 2 of the PO-UCDT manuscript box for box (spec .agent/sprints/S-002-spec.md is normative for code AND manuscript §4.2): per-unit weather, AirGradient, DEM/WorldCover/OSM static layers, per-unit π(r,i) and alerts, counterfactual what-if, Algorithm 1 maturity. Open: B-017 (info-modal text).

**Stack:** Python, TypeScript, TSX, CSS, SQL, FastAPI, arq, SQLAlchemy Core + Alembic, PostGIS, Bun + Hono, Redis, Vite + React 19, TanStack Query, react-router 7, use-intl, Tailwind v4 + shadcn, Mapbox GL, Caddy, GitHub Actions + GHCR

## Architecture

### Infrastructure, CI and deploy

Full-stack compose behind Caddy, the production override (GHCR images, daily backups, Uptime Kuma), the VPS deploy/restore scripts and runbook, the web image, env template, GitHub Actions (per-service required checks + GHCR images), and the one-shot parity generator.

- `package.json` — pnpm workspace root. Scripts: `pnpm parity` regenerates the golden fixture from the legacy TS backend. Every JS dependency for web/gateway/contracts was declared up front in T-001 — seam owners must not add dependencies (ask the lead).
- `infra/compose.yml` — The whole stack: postgres, redis, migrate (one-shot alembic upgrade head), climate-api, climate-worker (one image via a YAML anchor), gateway, caddy. Only caddy publishes ports (80/443). Start order is enforced by healthchecks (postgres -> migrate completed -> api /healthz -> gateway /health -> caddy). mem_limits total ~1.6 GB cap; measured ~213 MiB. Redis: persistence OFF, allkeys-lru 64 MB — cache/queue/pub-sub, never a store. LANDMINE: running it without compose.dev.yml drops the 127.0.0.1 ports the host dev loop and pytest need.
- `infra/Caddyfile` — /api/* -> gateway:3001 with flush_interval -1 and deliberately NO encode (compression buffers SSE); everything else is the SPA (try_files -> index.html, zstd/gzip, immutable /assets). SITE_ADDRESS :80 or a domain for auto-HTTPS.
- `infra/web.Dockerfile` — Builds apps/web with pnpm (corepack, --filter web...) and bakes VITE_* build args into the bundle, then copies dist + Caddyfile into caddy:2-alpine. Copies packages/contracts too: tsc -b resolves @ucdt/contracts by path. VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN is required.
- `.dockerignore` — Root build-context ignore for the web and gateway images (both build from the repo root): node_modules, dist, .venv, .git, .claude, .agent, env files.
- `infra/compose.dev.yml` — Dev override publishing postgres :5432 and redis :6379 on 127.0.0.1 so host processes (uv run, bun --watch, vite) reach them. Never used on the VPS.
- `infra/.env.example` — The only env template. VITE_* are baked into the static bundle at build time (not secrets; the Mapbox token is URL-scoped). SITE_ADDRESS=:80 serves by IP; a domain turns on Caddy auto-HTTPS.
- `.github/workflows/climate.yml` — CI for services/climate: PostGIS service container, uv sync --locked (cached), ruff check + format, pytest, then the CONTRACTS DRIFT CHECK — dump the climate OpenAPI, `pnpm -F @ucdt/contracts gen`, `git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts` (a schema change without regenerated contracts fails here). Deliberately NO path filter — a required check skipped by a filter would block unrelated PRs. Concurrency cancels superseded runs.
- `.github/workflows/gateway.yml` — CI for apps/gateway: bun test + tsc. Concurrency per ref, timeout-minutes.
- `.github/workflows/web.yml` — CI for apps/web: lint, vitest, vite build with a placeholder VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN (env.ts throws without one). routes.test waits up to 4 s for lazy route chunks (a cold runner once took 1.1 s, #34).
- `tools/gen-parity.ts` — Golden-fixture generator: runs the LEGACY ../Hackathon-BE/src (read-only sibling repo, must be checked out next to ucdt) on canned inputs — pure-function grids plus 11 scenarios, each in a fresh child process with Date frozen, TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh and fetch mocked. Output is services/climate/tests/fixtures/parity.json. LANDMINE: the fixture bakes in legacy B-012 (UTC current-hour pick), so the compute layer takes weather as given and the ingest fix is tested separately.
- `.github/workflows/images.yml` — Builds the three GHCR images on every PR (build only) and pushes them on push to dev/main: ghcr.io/codeforfee/ucdt-climate (services/climate), ucdt-gateway (apps/gateway/Dockerfile, root context), ucdt-web (infra/web.Dockerfile). Tags: branch name, sha-<short>, latest on main only — the contract compose.prod.yml pulls. Job ids are *-image so they never collide with the required climate/gateway/web checks. web-image SKIPS with a ::warning:: while the VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN repo secret is empty (never builds with a placeholder).
- `infra/compose.prod.yml` — Production override, always used together with compose.yml: swaps every app service to ghcr.io/codeforfee/ucdt-*:${UCDT_TAG:-main} (rollback = UCDT_TAG=sha-xxxx), adds `backup` (postgres:16-alpine, daily pg_dump -Fc into ${BACKUP_DIR:-/var/backups/ucdt}, keep 7) and `uptime-kuma` published ONLY on 127.0.0.1:3100 (reach it over an SSH tunnel). LANDMINE: compose.yml still interpolates VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN as a required build arg, so infra/.env on the VPS needs it even though prod never builds.
- `infra/deploy.sh` — VPS deploy, run from the repo root by the user (agents never SSH): refuses without infra/.env, git pull --ff-only, compose pull, up -d --no-build --remove-orphans --wait, ps, image prune. UCDT_TAG selects the image tag for rollback.
- `infra/backup/entrypoint.sh` — Entrypoint of the backup service: runs backup.sh immediately, then every 24 h; a failed run is logged and retried, never crashes the container. LANDMINE: every script here must be committed 100755 — a Windows checkout silently commits 100644, Docker Desktop hides it, and on Linux the service crash-loops with exit 126 (caught in PR #37). Use `git update-index --chmod=+x`.
- `infra/backup/backup.sh` — POSIX sh: one pg_dump -Fc of $PGDATABASE into $BACKUP_DIR/<db>-<UTC ts>.dump, logged to stdout and backup.log, then prunes to the newest $KEEP (7). A failed dump is deleted, not kept half-written.
- `infra/backup/restore.sh` — Host-side restore of a dump into the running postgres container: typed-name confirmation, stops climate-api/climate-worker/backup, dropdb --force, createdb, pg_restore, and restarts those services from an EXIT trap (also on failure). RESTORE_DRY_RUN=1 prints the stop/start instead of running them. Proven against a held connection into a scratch DB.
- `docs/DEPLOY.md` — Vietnamese VPS runbook: Docker install, hardening checklist (sudo user + SSH key, PermitRootLogin/PasswordAuthentication no, ufw 22/80/443, unattended-upgrades, fail2ban), private clone, docker login ghcr.io (PAT read:packages), infra/.env, first deploy / update / rollback, backup copy-off + restore, Uptime Kuma via ssh -L 3100, troubleshooting. Written, not yet run on a real VPS.

### Processing layer — PDIM (pure Python)

Every coefficient and formula of PDIM Stage 1, with no I/O, so one code path scores live snapshots, what-ifs and fixtures. Ported from Hackathon-BE with 1e-9 parity. Owner of DP3.

- `services/climate/climate/__init__.py` — Package docstring stating the rule: this package owns the DB schema, ingestion, every PDIM coefficient and formula, snapshots, rules and simulation. Nothing outside it computes a value it owns (DP3).
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/constants.py` — SINGLE source of truth for every PDIM Stage-1 coefficient: flood w1..w4 = .45/.30/.25/.15, Θ=(.25,.5,.75), rainRef 50 mm/h; heat α=0.15, UHI 3.5 °C; AQI β=0.3, γ_w=.05, γ_p=.15; green->drain 0.003; AQI_CATEGORIES bands. Ported verbatim from legacy constants.ts; parity-tested. One known web copy: the flood weights in apps/web features/flood (B-014, #26).
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/risk.py` — Scalar response functions (flood_risk_score R_f = w1P+w2T+w3I-w4D, flood_risk_level, heat_index, effective_temp, aqi_nowcast_step, estimated_depth_m) plus the JS-parity helpers js_round / to_fixed / js_iso. LANDMINE: use js_round, never Python round() — banker's rounding breaks payload parity at .5 ties; same for isoformat vs toISOString.
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/flood.py` — City + per-zone flood risk over the 18 zones. flood_areas() is shared by baseline and what-if so before/after run on ONE grid. Zones under 0.15 are not reported. Returns all four R_f terms (B-011).
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/heat.py` — Heat/UHI hotspots over the 22 heat cells from current temperature + humidity; heat_risk_level bands 37/40/44 °C.
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/aqi.py` — EPA PM2.5 -> US AQI breakpoints, Open-Meteo `current` -> raw mapping, the S1 gamma nowcast over 24 h and the AQIResponse assembly (city + 23 stations; a failed station is dropped, not zeroed).
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/simulation.py` — What-if = Algorithm 2 step 7 (spec §G): validate_scenario bounds every lever and rejects NaN/inf/bool; run_counterfactual re-runs steps 3–6 on the counterfactual state (P_sim, D̃_sim, T_eff+ΔT with ΔT = −0.15ΔG + 3.5(ρ−ρ₀), per-point AQI_sim) and returns results.stations plus counterfactual{recommendations, firedCount, alerts (never persisted), bandChanges}.
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/rules.py` — Rule base ℛ per unit (spec §E–§F): unit_values() → recommendations() ranks every fired (r, i) by π = S(b)·E(i)·F(a) with E(i) = clamp(builtUp, 0.1, 1), top-10 + firedCount, R-NORM-00 when none; band_alerts() fires on band RISES vs the previous snapshot with ids `<hazard>:<unit>:<band>:<local hour>` and per-hazard expiry (ALERT_BANDS). Every item carries ruleId, π and inputs.
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/geo.py` — GeoJSON helpers: deterministic seeded 20-vertex flood blob per zone (grows with risk), feature builder, haversine.
- `services/climate/climate/spatial/units.py` — The 63 spatial units: 18 FLOOD_ZONES, 22 HEAT_CELLS, 23 AQI_POINTS (+ ALL_UNITS). Named by coordinate-anchored TOPONYMS, never administrative units (district tier abolished 2025); `id` keeps the historic slug as an internal key only. Only the expert constant localDrain (D̃) remains hand-set; terrain, imperviousness and density come from derived.json via catalogue.py (S-002).
- `services/climate/climate/spatial/catalogue.py` — load_catalogue(): the immutable join of units.py and derived.json that every PDIM module scores on (flood_zones, heat_cells, aqi_points with their derived fields). legacy_catalogue() keeps the pre-S-002 constants for the parity fixture only.
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/maturity.py` — Algorithm 1 (spec §H), stateless, evaluated on every /v1/maturity read: W = 14 d, δ = 2 AQI; AQI D(S2) = ≥168 consecutive hour pairs over ≥7 days; OLS without intercept on ln-ratio (70/30 split, t-quantile 95 % CI); promotes S2 when holdout MAE beats S1 by δ, demotes on the next failing read. Flood/heat have D = false with stated reasons; S3 needs 12 months. nowcast_gammas feeds the served nowcast.

### Data layer — Postgres/PostGIS

Ingest clients (Open-Meteo + AQ fallbacks), hand-written migrations, Core tables, a dict-returning async repository.

- `services/climate/climate/config.py` — pydantic-settings Settings (DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL — defaults on 127.0.0.1, not localhost (::1 first on Windows: Redis timeouts, 2 s Postgres connects), optional IQAIR/AQICN keys, ingest every 15 min, stale after 45 min, city hcmc, tz Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh), cached by get_settings(). Reads services/climate/.env.
- `services/climate/climate/ingest/weather.py` — Open-Meteo forecast client + transform_forecast. B-012 fix: the current hour is matched in HCMC LOCAL time via Open-Meteo's utc_offset_seconds (not zoneinfo — Windows lacks tzdata and no dep may be added). Requests forecast_days=2 so 24 forecast hours always exist.
- `services/climate/climate/ingest/air.py` — Air-quality fetch: Open-Meteo Air Quality first, IQAir / AQICN fallbacks only when their keys are set. Returns None on failure; a failed station is dropped.
- `services/climate/climate/db/models.py` — SQLAlchemy Core tables mirroring migration 001 (spatial_units, weather_obs, aqi_obs, risk_snapshots, alerts) plus a tiny Geography(Point,4326) type — no geoalchemy2, no ORM. Migrations own the schema; this file only types columns.
- `services/climate/climate/db/repo.py` — Async data access returning plain dicts: insert weather/aqi obs, insert_snapshot / latest_snapshot / history (oldest first), insert_alerts (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, returns only new ids), list_active_alerts, mark_alerts_read, list_spatial_units (lat/lng via ST_Y/ST_X). None of them commit — the caller owns the transaction.
- `services/climate/climate/db/session.py` — Cached async engine + sessionmaker. Usage: `async with get_sessionmaker()() as s, s.begin(): ...`.
- `services/climate/climate/db/migrations/env.py` — Async alembic env. Hand-written migrations, no autogenerate (no target_metadata). URL comes from config.attributes['url'] (tests) or Settings.
- `services/climate/climate/db/migrations/versions/001_initial.py` — Initial schema + seed of the 63 spatial_units from spatial/units.py. risk_snapshots store inputs AND result as JSONB with model_version, so every served score is reproducible.
- `services/climate/climate/spatial/derive.py` — One-off deriver of the STATIC layers (spec §A.2–A.3), run by hand, never by the worker: elevation z + slope s = 100·max(|zE−zW|,|zN−zS|)/1000 from a 4-point 500 m stencil (Copernicus DEM GLO-90 via the Open-Meteo Elevation API), ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 class fractions in a 2×2 km window read as rasterio COG windows (builtUp=50, green=10/20/30/90/95, water=80), OSM Overpass 2025 commune + road density (segment midpoint within 1 km, km/π km²), nearest-neighbour mappings. Responses cached in derive_cache.json so a rerun is offline. LANDMINE: Overpass returns 406 without a User-Agent and 504s under load (retries in _get_json).
- `services/climate/climate/spatial/derived.json` — COMMITTED output of derive.py — do not hand-edit: per-unit z, s, T̃, builtUp/green/water, commune, roadDensity, flood→AQI and station mappings, served baselines ρ₀ 0.708 / G₀ 21.8 %, plus provenance (sources, licences, retrieval date 2026-09-24). Copernicus DEM is a DSM (the manuscript states the caveat).
- `services/climate/climate/db/migrations/versions/002_static_layers.py` — Renames the 12 district-named heat cells to street/landmark toponyms at the same coordinates (spec §A.1). Renames only — derived static values live in derived.json, not the DB.

### Climate runtime — worker + API

The two processes of the one climate image: the arq worker that ingests, scores and publishes every 15 min, and the internal FastAPI the gateway calls.

- `services/climate/climate/snapshots.py` — store_run(): one scoring run inside the CALLER's transaction — observations, the five risk_snapshots (weather, aqi, flood, heat, recommend; result = legacy /api/<hazard> data, model_version pdim-s1) and new alerts. LANDMINE: heat is stored in heatController's reshaped form (heat_payload), not compute_heat's raw output — the web and the API model depend on that.
- `services/climate/climate/worker/main.py` — arq WorkerSettings: cron every ingest_interval_minutes + at startup: fetch all -> store_run -> commit -> publish ucdt:events. Any upstream failure skips the run (no half snapshot set). Run once: `uv run arq climate.worker.main.WorkerSettings --burst`.
- `services/climate/climate/api/main.py` — FastAPI internal API (only client: the gateway). /v1/{hazard}/latest adds observedAt + stale (> 45 min); 503 until a snapshot exists (gateway turns it into 502). /v1/simulation runs live on the latest weather+flood+aqi snapshots. /v1/alerts, /v1/alerts/read, /v1/history/{hazard}?hours=1..168, /healthz.
- `services/climate/climate/api/models.py` — Pydantic response/request models mirroring the legacy shapes; SimulationRequest bounds = validate_scenario. Source of the OpenAPI schema.
- `services/climate/Dockerfile` — One image for api (default CMD uvicorn :8000), worker (arq ...) and migrate (alembic upgrade head). uv, non-root uid 10001, ~300 MB.
- `services/climate/climate/ingest/airgradient.py` — fetch_airgradient(): the keyless AirGradient open network inside the HCMC bbox (lat 10.3–11.2, lng 106.3–107.1); readings older than 2 h are dropped and station names pass the §A.1 guard. Stored as aqi_obs `ag:<id>` and mapped to the nearest AQI point.
- `services/climate/climate/ingest/names.py` — §A.1 administrative-name guard (accent-folded regex + former district list) used by ingest and by every name test. `commune` (official 2025 name, 'Phường …') is API/data-only and must never be rendered: it reuses the abolished district words.

### Climate tests

Parity against the legacy backend, regression invariants for legacy bugs, and DB tests on a throwaway ucdt_test database.

- `services/climate/tests/pdim/test_pdim_parity.py` — Numeric parity with the legacy TS backend: every pure group and every scenario from parity.json within 1e-9, strings exact; simulationId/alert ids compared by shape only.
- `services/climate/tests/pdim/test_pdim_invariants.py` — Regression invariants for legacy bugs B-004, B-005, B-008, B-011 plus alert dedupe/refire and dropped-station AQI.
- `services/climate/tests/pdim/test_pdim_legacy.py` — Ports of legacy riskCalculator / scenarioValidation / spatialNaming tests, including the assertion that no API-surface name carries an administrative label.
- `services/climate/tests/db/conftest.py` — DB tests use a SEPARATE database `ucdt_test` on the DATABASE_URL server, created if missing and migrated once per session; each test runs in a rolled-back transaction. Needs compose postgres up.
- `services/climate/tests/fixtures/parity.json` — Generated by tools/gen-parity.ts — do not hand-edit. 695 pure cases + 11 scenarios.
- `services/climate/tests/api/conftest.py` — API tests on their own database `ucdt_test_api` (sharing ucdt_test with tests/db races: tests/db downgrades it to base).
- `services/climate/tests/worker/test_worker.py` — Parity scenario through faked HTTP -> worker -> real DB: each stored result equals legacy /api/<hazard> within 1e-9; events only after commit; failed fetch writes nothing. DB `ucdt_test_worker`.

### Gateway — Bun + Hono

The only public API. Envelope, cache, rate limit, SSE, CORS. Never touches the DB, never computes a domain value.

- `apps/gateway/src/index.ts` — Bun entry (defaults CLIMATE_URL http://127.0.0.1:8000, REDIS_URL 127.0.0.1 — not localhost, which is slow on Windows): builds TWO RedisClients (commands + a dedicated pub/sub subscriber, B-013) and serves the Hono app on :3001 with idleTimeout 0 so SSE is not cut.
- `apps/gateway/src/app.ts` — The public /api/* surface. Middleware: CORS *, secure headers, 64 KB body limit, logger, Redis rate limit. /api/{weather,aqi,flood,heat,recommend} -> GET /v1/<x>/latest with per-route cache TTL; alerts never cached; GET /api/simulation maps legacy query params onto the POST body; /api/stream relays Redis channel `ucdt:events`, using the JSON `type` field as the SSE event name.
- `apps/gateway/src/climate.ts` — forward(): the ONLY code that talks to CLIMATE_URL. Wraps bare climate JSON in the legacy {success,data,timestamp,cached} envelope so Hackathon-FE keeps working; maps 404->404, FastAPI 422->400 with a flattened message, anything else non-2xx or unreachable -> 502.
- `apps/gateway/src/cache.ts` — GET-only, 200-only Redis response cache keyed by full URL, X-Cache HIT/MISS. Fails OPEN when Redis is down.
- `apps/gateway/src/rateLimit.ts` — 100 req/min per IP (first X-Forwarded-For hop) via INCR+EXPIRE, X-RateLimit-* headers, 429 with retryAfter. Fails OPEN when Redis is down.
- `apps/gateway/src/redis.ts` — RedisLike: the slice of Redis the gateway uses; Bun's RedisClient satisfies it structurally, tests inject a fake.
- `apps/gateway/tests/fakes.ts` — In-memory Redis fake that, like real Redis, rejects key commands once subscribed (B-013 guard); a Redis that fails every call; a fake climate fetch.

### Web shell

Entry, providers, env, router and build config of the Vite SPA.

- `apps/web/src/main.tsx` — Browser entry: mounts <App/> in StrictMode.
- `apps/web/src/App.tsx` — Provider stack: TanStack QueryClient, use-intl IntlProvider (vi/en from a zustand locale store), RouterProvider, devtools.
- `apps/web/src/config/env.ts` — zod-validated env. VITE_API_BASE_URL may be EMPTY (same-origin /api via Vite proxy or Caddy). VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN is required — the app throws at import without it, including in CI builds.
- `apps/web/src/router/routes.tsx` — The route table, in its own module so tests build a memory router from the exact shipped routes. /dashboard, /map, /simulation/{heat,flood,aqi}, /flood, /air-quality, /alerts; every page lazy-loaded. Nav shows only 4 tabs (Board decision 2026-09-14); air-quality and alerts are URL-reachable.
- `apps/web/src/router/` — Router plumbing: index (createBrowserRouter), lazyPage (code-split pages), RouteErrorBoundary, SimulationLayout (tab bar), NotFoundPage, routes.test.
- `apps/web/vite.config.ts` — React Compiler via babel (slow builds by design), Tailwind v4, @ alias, rolldown codeSplitting groups keeping recharts and mapbox-gl off routes that do not use them. Dev proxy /api -> 127.0.0.1:3001 with timeouts disabled for SSE.
- `apps/web/eslint.config.js` — Enforces feature isolation (features cannot import each other; shared cannot import a feature) — Board decision 2026-09-14.
- `apps/web/src/messages/` — i18n catalogues vi.json / en.json for use-intl.
- `apps/web/src/components/ui/` — shadcn/ui primitives (base-ui). Generated; excluded from ESLint.

### Web shared layer

Everything features may import: network, query hooks, live events, types, UI components, UI-only stores. Presentation only — it renders what the API computed.

- `apps/web/src/shared/hooks/useLiveEvents.ts` — The app's single EventSource on /api/stream (mount once, in AppLayout). `snapshot.updated` {hazard} invalidates that hazard's query via the KEY registry; `alert.created` invalidates alerts. CONTRACT: the worker (T-006) must publish JSON with `type` in {snapshot.updated, alert.created} and `hazard` matching a KEY in shared/utils/queryKeys.ts, or live refresh silently does nothing.
- `apps/web/src/shared/lib/axios.ts` — The single axios instance (baseURL from env, 10 s timeout) and unwrap(), which peels the gateway's {success,data} envelope.
- `apps/web/src/shared/utils/queryKeys.ts` — KEY registry for TanStack Query keys; useLiveEvents maps SSE hazard names through it, so hook keys and invalidation cannot drift.
- `apps/web/src/shared/services/` — One thin fetcher per endpoint (weather, aqi, flood, heat, history, recommend, simulation, alerts) — apiClient.get/post + unwrap, nothing computed.
- `apps/web/src/shared/hooks/` — TanStack Query hooks over the services (useWeatherData, useAQIData, useFloodRisk, useHeatMap, useHistory, useRecommend, useSimulation, useAlerts, useMarkAlertsRead) plus useLiveEvents.
- `apps/web/src/shared/types/` — App-facing types, derived from @ucdt/contracts (type-only path in tsconfig.app.json; web does not list the package as a dependency).
- `apps/web/src/shared/lib/aqi.ts` — US AQI display bands (colour + i18n code) used by every legend and marker. Display only — not a PDIM term; the AQI VALUE always comes from the API.
- `apps/web/src/shared/components/` — Shared UI ported from Hackathon-FE: layout (AppLayout, Header, ThemeToggle, PageLoader), charts (recharts wrappers, AQIGauge, HeatmapGrid), common (RiskBadge, DataSourceTag, ErrorState...), map (3D buildings, terrain, boot overlay, layer lifecycle).
- `apps/web/src/shared/stores/` — zustand stores for UI state only (city, map, simulation sliders, alerts panel, locale). Never cache server data here — that is TanStack Query's job.
- `apps/web/src/shared/components/layout/AlertsBell.tsx` — Header bell: unread badge + dropdown of per-unit alerts (severity, toponym, title, time), mark-read one/all via POST /api/alerts/read, empty state, live via SSE invalidation. The Alert payload has no unitId, so the toponym is joined by splitting the §F id `<hazard>:<unitId>:<band>:<hour>` against /api/units.

### Web features

The six screens, isolated from each other by ESLint; each renders what the API computed.

- `apps/web/src/features/dashboard/` — Overview: summary cards, risk banner, 24 h charts, data-source chips and the MaturityCard (Algorithm 1 line 8: active stage, criteria current/required, S2 γ with 95 % CI). Recommendations moved to their own tab and alerts to the header bell (S-002). lib/weatherOutlook: 'vs 24 h ago' only when history spans >= 23 h (B-007, B-015).
- `apps/web/src/features/flood/` — Flood page: per-zone table + RiskDecomposition rendered from the SERVED decomposition (city and per zone), drainage subtractive, each term naming its data source. The web keeps no flood weights (B-014 closed by deleting decomposeFloodRisk.ts).
- `apps/web/src/features/air-quality/` — Air-quality page: stations, EPA bands from shared/lib/aqi.ts, provenance = Open-Meteo.
- `apps/web/src/features/alerts/` — Full alerts page (/alerts, reached from the header bell's 'All' link): list + mark-read via POST /api/alerts/read.
- `apps/web/src/features/map/` — Full Mapbox map with flood/heat/AQI layers and controls. mapbox-gl stays in its own chunk; init failure (no WebGL) is logged and leaves the boot overlay up. Needs a real VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN to paint.
- `apps/web/src/features/simulation/` — Heat/flood/AQI what-if pages. No local PDIM: sliders debounce POST /api/simulation; scenarioRequest sends ΔG = G − served G₀ and omits an untouched urbanDensity (scored at ρ₀). Each simulator renders ScenarioRecommendations (counterfactual top-k, band changes, would-fire alerts; AQI also per-point before→after from results.stations) and AirGradient stations. ComparePanel never shows population/buildings (B-016).
- `apps/web/src/features/recommendations/` — Recommendations tab (/recommendations, 5th nav tab): the ranked top-k π(r,i) list with toponym, rule, π, the rule's inputs ('Vì sao') and firedCount; R-NORM-00 when nothing fired. `commune` never rendered.

### Contracts

OpenAPI schema dumped from the climate API and the TS types generated from it.

- `packages/contracts/package.json` — @ucdt/contracts: `gen` runs openapi-typescript over openapi.json (--default-non-nullable false so defaulted request fields stay optional).
- `packages/contracts/openapi.json` — Generated by `uv run python -m climate.api.dump_openapi` — do not hand-edit. Regenerating must produce no diff (T-007 exit).
- `packages/contracts/src/schema.ts` — Generated TS types for the climate API, consumed type-only by apps/web through a tsconfig path. CI fails on drift.

## Start here

1. **The rule everything follows** — Python owns every PDIM number (DP3). The gateway only reshapes, the web only renders. Read the package docstring, then constants.py — every coefficient in the system is there and nowhere else. (`services/climate/climate/__init__.py`, `services/climate/climate/pdim/constants.py`)
2. **The formulas** — risk.py holds R_f, heat index, UHI and the AQI nowcast plus the JS-parity helpers; flood/heat/aqi assemble per-hazard responses over the 63 spatial units. (`services/climate/climate/pdim/risk.py`, `services/climate/climate/pdim/flood.py`, `services/climate/climate/spatial/units.py`)
3. **What-if and rules** — simulation.py (Algorithm 2) and rules.py (pi = S·E·F, traceable recommendations, deduped alerts). (`services/climate/climate/pdim/simulation.py`, `services/climate/climate/pdim/rules.py`)
4. **How parity is proven** — gen-parity.ts runs the legacy backend to produce parity.json; test_pdim_parity asserts the port within 1e-9. (`tools/gen-parity.ts`, `services/climate/tests/pdim/test_pdim_parity.py`)
5. **How data arrives** — worker/main.py fetches Open-Meteo every 15 min, snapshots.store_run scores and stores five snapshots in one transaction, then publishes ucdt:events. (`services/climate/climate/worker/main.py`, `services/climate/climate/snapshots.py`, `services/climate/climate/ingest/weather.py`)
6. **Storage** — Migration 001 seeds the units; repo.py is the only data access and never commits. (`services/climate/climate/db/migrations/versions/001_initial.py`, `services/climate/climate/db/repo.py`)
7. **Where a browser request lands** — Gateway app.ts: rate limit, cache, then climate.ts forwards to the FastAPI /v1/* and wraps the legacy envelope. index.ts keeps a separate Redis connection for SSE (B-013). (`apps/gateway/src/app.ts`, `apps/gateway/src/climate.ts`, `services/climate/climate/api/main.py`)
8. **The web app** — routes.tsx lists every screen; shared/ services + hooks fetch and unwrap; useLiveEvents turns SSE into query invalidation. (`apps/web/src/router/routes.tsx`, `apps/web/src/shared/hooks`, `apps/web/src/shared/hooks/useLiveEvents.ts`)
9. **Run it** — Whole stack: `docker compose -f infra/compose.yml up -d --build` -> http://localhost. Dev loop: compose.dev.yml for postgres + redis on loopback, then uvicorn / arq --burst / bun / vite (API_PROXY_TARGET if :3001 is taken). Production: push to dev/main publishes GHCR images; on the VPS `infra/deploy.sh` pulls them (docs/DEPLOY.md). (`infra/compose.yml`, `infra/Caddyfile`, `infra/compose.dev.yml`, `infra/compose.prod.yml`, `infra/deploy.sh`)

## Landmines

- `infra/compose.yml` — The whole stack: postgres, redis, migrate (one-shot alembic upgrade head), climate-api, climate-worker (one image via a YAML anchor), gateway, caddy. Only caddy publishes ports (80/443). Start order is enforced by healthchecks (postgres -> migrate completed -> api /healthz -> gateway /health -> caddy). mem_limits total ~1.6 GB cap; measured ~213 MiB. Redis: persistence OFF, allkeys-lru 64 MB — cache/queue/pub-sub, never a store. LANDMINE: running it without compose.dev.yml drops the 127.0.0.1 ports the host dev loop and pytest need.
- `tools/gen-parity.ts` — Golden-fixture generator: runs the LEGACY ../Hackathon-BE/src (read-only sibling repo, must be checked out next to ucdt) on canned inputs — pure-function grids plus 11 scenarios, each in a fresh child process with Date frozen, TZ=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh and fetch mocked. Output is services/climate/tests/fixtures/parity.json. LANDMINE: the fixture bakes in legacy B-012 (UTC current-hour pick), so the compute layer takes weather as given and the ingest fix is tested separately.
- `services/climate/climate/ingest/weather.py` — Open-Meteo forecast client + transform_forecast. B-012 fix: the current hour is matched in HCMC LOCAL time via Open-Meteo's utc_offset_seconds (not zoneinfo — Windows lacks tzdata and no dep may be added). Requests forecast_days=2 so 24 forecast hours always exist.
- `services/climate/climate/snapshots.py` — store_run(): one scoring run inside the CALLER's transaction — observations, the five risk_snapshots (weather, aqi, flood, heat, recommend; result = legacy /api/<hazard> data, model_version pdim-s1) and new alerts. LANDMINE: heat is stored in heatController's reshaped form (heat_payload), not compute_heat's raw output — the web and the API model depend on that.
- `services/climate/climate/pdim/risk.py` — Scalar response functions (flood_risk_score R_f = w1P+w2T+w3I-w4D, flood_risk_level, heat_index, effective_temp, aqi_nowcast_step, estimated_depth_m) plus the JS-parity helpers js_round / to_fixed / js_iso. LANDMINE: use js_round, never Python round() — banker's rounding breaks payload parity at .5 ties; same for isoformat vs toISOString.
- `apps/web/src/config/env.ts` — zod-validated env. VITE_API_BASE_URL may be EMPTY (same-origin /api via Vite proxy or Caddy). VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN is required — the app throws at import without it, including in CI builds.
- `apps/web/src/features/flood` — Flood page: per-zone table + RiskDecomposition rendered from the SERVED decomposition (city and per zone), drainage subtractive, each term naming its data source. The web keeps no flood weights (B-014 closed by deleting decomposeFloodRisk.ts).
- `apps/web/src/shared/hooks/useLiveEvents.ts` — The app's single EventSource on /api/stream (mount once, in AppLayout). `snapshot.updated` {hazard} invalidates that hazard's query via the KEY registry; `alert.created` invalidates alerts. CONTRACT: the worker (T-006) must publish JSON with `type` in {snapshot.updated, alert.created} and `hazard` matching a KEY in shared/utils/queryKeys.ts, or live refresh silently does nothing.
- `infra/compose.prod.yml` — Production override, always used together with compose.yml: swaps every app service to ghcr.io/codeforfee/ucdt-*:${UCDT_TAG:-main} (rollback = UCDT_TAG=sha-xxxx), adds `backup` (postgres:16-alpine, daily pg_dump -Fc into ${BACKUP_DIR:-/var/backups/ucdt}, keep 7) and `uptime-kuma` published ONLY on 127.0.0.1:3100 (reach it over an SSH tunnel). LANDMINE: compose.yml still interpolates VITE_MAPBOX_TOKEN as a required build arg, so infra/.env on the VPS needs it even though prod never builds.
- `infra/backup/entrypoint.sh` — Entrypoint of the backup service: runs backup.sh immediately, then every 24 h; a failed run is logged and retried, never crashes the container. LANDMINE: every script here must be committed 100755 — a Windows checkout silently commits 100644, Docker Desktop hides it, and on Linux the service crash-loops with exit 126 (caught in PR #37). Use `git update-index --chmod=+x`.
- `services/climate/climate/spatial/derive.py` — One-off deriver of the STATIC layers (spec §A.2–A.3), run by hand, never by the worker: elevation z + slope s = 100·max(|zE−zW|,|zN−zS|)/1000 from a 4-point 500 m stencil (Copernicus DEM GLO-90 via the Open-Meteo Elevation API), ESA WorldCover 2021 v200 class fractions in a 2×2 km window read as rasterio COG windows (builtUp=50, green=10/20/30/90/95, water=80), OSM Overpass 2025 commune + road density (segment midpoint within 1 km, km/π km²), nearest-neighbour mappings. Responses cached in derive_cache.json so a rerun is offline. LANDMINE: Overpass returns 406 without a User-Agent and 504s under load (retries in _get_json).
- `services/climate/climate/ingest/names.py` — §A.1 administrative-name guard (accent-folded regex + former district list) used by ingest and by every name test. `commune` (official 2025 name, 'Phường …') is API/data-only and must never be rendered: it reuses the abolished district words.
